description: Land Acquisition - Uda Aparekka, Devinuwara D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically describes the government's intention to acquire two parcels of land for public purpose, provides detailed descriptions of the properties (including location, extent, and current use), and outlines the legal process for interested parties to make compensation claims. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisition, property descriptions, and land-related legal procedures.
